import os,json
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); mr,mc=h//2,w//2
    out=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        grown=[[v for j,v in enumerate(row) for _ in range(1 if j==mc else 2)]]
        rep=1 if i==mr else 2
        out+=grown*rep
    return out
